items.markdown:
![Thailand Map](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262109-1672-0139-0000-457fce422414:4)
Planning a trip to Thailand involves `exploring Bangkok, visiting Chiang Mai, and relaxing on southern islands like Phuket or Koh Phi Phi` . The best time to visit is the cool, dry season from November to March.[](https://thailandstartshere.com/thailand-travel-advice/) [[1]](https://thailandstartshere.com/thailand-travel-advice/)[[2]](https://thaiadventureclub.com/trip-planner-thailand/)

Suggested 10-Day Itinerary

- **Days 1–3 (Bangkok):** See the [Grand Palace](https://www.royalgrandpalace.th/en/home) and Wat Pho, ride a tuk-tuk, and visit floating markets.
- **Days 4–6 (Chiang Mai):** Fly north to see mountain temples like Doi Suthep and visit ethical elephant sanctuaries.
- **Days 7–10 (Southern Islands):** Fly to Phuket or Krabi for island hopping, boat tours to Phi Phi Islands, and beach days.[](https://www.global-gallivanting.com/2-week-thailand-itinerary/) [[1]](https://www.global-gallivanting.com/2-week-thailand-itinerary/)[[2]](https://www.asiaodysseytravel.com/thailand/10-days-itinerary.html)[[3]](https://apassionandapassport.com/two-weeks-in-thailand-itinerary/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DBBzSYFS4U3/)

Quick Travel Tips

- **Weather:** November to March is dry and cool; May to October brings the rainy season.
- **Transport:** Use low-cost ride-hailing apps like Grab or domestic budget flights to move between regions.
- **Culture:** Dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees) when visiting Buddhist temples.[](https://www.travelfish.org/trip_planner/where-to-go-in/thailand) [[1]](https://www.travelfish.org/trip_planner/where-to-go-in/thailand)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SS1V8lY3A5g&t=166)
